cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(gps_msgs)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)

set(MSG_DEPS std_msgs builtin_interfaces)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rosidl_default_generators REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(builtin_interfaces REQUIRED)

set(MSG_FILES
  msg/GPSFix.msg
  msg/GPSStatus.msg
)

# The GPSDRaw<MAJOR>v<MINOR> family and its sub-messages are generated by
# tools/generate_raw_msgs.py, one set per gpsd API pair. They are globbed
# rather than listed so regenerating does not also require editing this file;
# CI runs the generator with --check so the checked-in set cannot drift.
#
# Note these are built unconditionally, with no libgps dependency: gps_msgs is
# a pure interface package and must stay buildable everywhere (D1).
file(GLOB GENERATED_MSG_FILES RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} msg/GPSD*.msg)
list(SORT GENERATED_MSG_FILES)
list(APPEND MSG_FILES ${GENERATED_MSG_FILES})

rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
  ${MSG_FILES}
  DEPENDENCIES ${MSG_DEPS}
)

ament_export_dependencies(rosidl_default_runtime)

#############
## Testing ##
#############

if(BUILD_TESTING)
  find_package(ament_cmake_pytest REQUIRED)

  # The GPSDRaw* messages in msg/ are generated by tools/generate_raw_msgs.py,
  # so their tests live with the generator rather than with a package. They run
  # here because gps_msgs owns the generated messages, which are the
  # generator's primary output.
  #
  # Neither suite links or needs libgps -- they read gps.h out of a gpsd git
  # clone and skip cleanly when it is absent, so gps_msgs stays buildable and
  # testable on the build farm (D1). Point GPSD_REPO at a clone to run them:
  #
  #   GPSD_REPO=/path/to/gpsd colcon test --packages-select gps_msgs
  #
  # tools/test_against_gpsd.sh maintains one at <workspace>/.gpsd_versions/gpsd,
  # which is the default.
  set(GENERATOR_TESTS
    test_generate_raw_msgs.py      # generator internals, synthetic fragments
    test_generated_messages.py     # generated output vs. the real gps.h
  )
  foreach(test_file ${GENERATOR_TESTS})
    ament_add_pytest_test(${test_file}
      "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/${test_file}"
      TIMEOUT 300)
  endforeach()
endif()

ament_package()

install(
  FILES ros1_ros2_mapping.yaml
  DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}
)
